thread:
Maya (CS): heads-up — running a 2-week sprint to bake an early-warning churn playbook. goal: detect accounts at 30/60/90-day renewal risk and a clear save path per segment. need owners for triggers, templates, and ops. who can pick up triggers?
Kevin (CSM): I can own triggers for mid-market — will start with low-usage + failed onboarding flows. will share example list by EOD.
Alex (PM): I'll own the playbook structure + rollout plan. can we make a single canonical doc that maps signals -> tactic -> owner -> playbook link?
Jamie (Data): I'll run cohort analysis tomorrow. preliminary signals I suggest: weekly MAU drop >30%, insert failures in onboarding pipeline, sudden token usage drop, repeated support tickets. SQL snippet I used for MAU diff:
```
SELECT account_id, date_trunc('week', ts) as wk, count(distinct user_id) as mau
FROM events
WHERE ts > now() - interval '90 days'
GROUP BY account_id, wk
ORDER BY account_id, wk;
```
Priya (Enablement): I'll draft two templates: 1) low-touch reactivation email + playbook, 2) high-touch renewal save script with success metrics to ask the customer. will include quick links and objection-handling bullets.
Maya (CS): great. also we need downgrade-safe paths — i.e., if they can't commit, provide a scaled plan instead of churn. Kevin, can you outline downgrade options when you validate with AMs?
Kevin (CSM): yes. plan to create a downgrade matrix: feature set vs price delta vs migration friction. will mock one by tomorrow.
Alex (PM): Ops question — how do we surface alerts into CSM workflow? Slack + Notion + ticket? ops-bot can create a ticket if threshold crossed?
ops-bot: integration check — I can post to #cs-alerts and create a Zendesk ticket with tags: churn_early_warning, cohort_<id>. need a webhook and the ruleset JSON.
Jamie (Data): proposed ruleset (rough):
- MAU drop: current_week_mau <= 0.7 * median(prev_4_weeks_mau)
- Onboarding step fail rate > 20% for a new account
- Daily tokens < 10% of expected baseline for paid tier
- 2+ support tickets in 7 days marked "blocking"
I'll export a sample list of accounts matching these by noon.
Maya (CS): love the rules. Alex — can we have a lightweight playbook for each rule: triage checklist, first-touch template, 72-hour escalation path, and fallback to dedicated support?
Alex (PM): yes. I'll create a template in Notion: sections: when to trigger, required context (usage graph, onboarding steps, last contact), 1P outreach script, 2P escalation matrix. linking it here when ready.
Priya (Enablement): also adding a short training for AE/CSM: 20-min session + cheat sheet. will schedule next Wed.
Kevin (CSM): quick ask — can Jamie flag accounts where churn risk overlaps with new feature adoption? helps prioritize saves that can be nudged with enablement.
Jamie (Data): yep — will add feature_adoption boolean. will tag "high-value" if ARR > $50k.
Maya (CS): operational detail: when owners are assigned, please add yourself to the Notion playbook as the owner and add a weekly status line in the project board.
Kevin (CSM): added to my calendar.
Alex (PM): timeline: trigger set + data validation by Thu, playbook templates by Mon next week, training scheduled Wed. who's on a demo of the flow after that?
Priya (Enablement): I'll run the training and can demo the playbook.
Maya (CS): outstanding blockers?
Kevin (CSM): need an export for "recently downgraded" accounts to test the downgrade messaging. Jamie?
Jamie (Data): I'll produce that list and include a small random sample for playtesting.
Maya (CS): perfect. final note: capture feedback after first 10 saves — we'll iterate. please drop updates in this thread only so we have an audit trail. :thumbsup:
Priya (Enablement): noted. adding a short feedback form for frontline CSMs.
ops-bot: reminder scheduled — post weekly summary to #cs-weekly on Fridays at 16:00.
Maya (CS): thanks team — assigning owners: triggers=Kevin/Jamie, templates=Priya, playbook=Alex, training=Priya. check-ins in 48h.
Kevin (CSM): ack.
Alex (PM): ack.
Jamie (Data): ack.
Priya (Enablement): ack.
